target_paper.title: Efficient Suzuki–Miyaura C-C Cross-Couplings Induced by Novel Heterodinuclear Pd-bpydc-Ln Scaffolds
target_paper.authors: Ding F; Li Y; Yan P; Deng Y; Wang D; Zhang Y; Dragutan I; Dragutan V; Wang K

table_location.table_caption: Suzuki–Miyaura cross-coupling of 4-bromoanisole with phenylboronic acid in methanol-induced by Pd-bpydc-Ln catalysts 1–3.

quantitative_method.basis: GC-calculated yields based on the amount of 4-bromoanisole employed
quantitative_method.source: Table 1 footnote c; General Procedure (Section 2.3): 'GC-calculated yields were based on the amount of 4-bromoanisole or 4-bromobenzonitrile employed'; Experimental Section 2.1: 'Conversions were determined using Agilent 7890 GC-MSD'

notes_and_discrepancies: The result reported for entry 7 (91.9%) is a GC yield (internal-standard based), NOT an isolated yield. The paper does not report isolated yields for Table 1 entries.

Table 1 footnote a spells the base as 'sodium tertbutoxide' (sodium tert-butoxide). The General Procedure (Section 2.3) refers to 'specified base (0.5 mmol)' without naming it; the Results text (Section 3) states the sodium tert-butoxide–methanol pair was best. No direct contradiction found; the base for Table 1 is sodium tert-butoxide per footnote a.
The atmosphere is stated as 'in air' in the General Procedure (Section 2.3). The table itself does not state the atmosphere.

Entry 7 carries superscript 'a', indicating 0.5 mol% catalyst loading (footnote a). The paired entry 8 (same catalyst, 60 °C, 4 h) carries superscript 'b' (0.2 mol% catalyst loading) with yield 88.9%.

The table footnote c defines the yield metric as 'reaction yield (%) for total conversion determined from the internal standard yield ... based on gas chromatography (GC), using hexadecane as internal standard.' The paper does not report a separate isolated yield or conversion percentage for entry 7.
fields_not_reported_or_unknown: Isolated yield: not reported for entry 7 (only GC yield reported).
Exact catalyst mass/weight: not reported (only mol% loading given).
Stirring rate, vessel type, and workup details specific to entry 7: not reported (general procedure applies).
Product characterization data for 4-methoxybiphenyl from entry 7 specifically: not reported per-entry (products identified by GC-MS and 1H NMR per general procedure).
